purpose: Teach: ウロウロ/かっこよく/光り/営む/釣る/働ける/チョン/リョウ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、駅前を、絶対、ウロウロ、絶対、しちゃったわ
lines.en: Sho, I actually ended up wandering around the station for ages.
lines.style: Warm, gentle opener. Soft self-aware laugh buried in the delivery. Relaxed pace, intimate — like sharing a small embarrassment with someone she trusts completely.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、運動会で、絶対、かっこよく、絶対、走るよ
lines.en: Mei-nee, I'm going to run really cool at the sports day. I'm serious.
lines.style: Bright, determined. Small but genuine pride in the words. Quick pace, earnest — a child making a promise to someone he wants to impress. No performance, just conviction.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、星の、絶対、光り、絶対、輝く、絶対、夜、絶対、お散歩、絶対、好きよ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, you know I really love taking walks on starlit nights like this. I do.
lines.style: Tender, almost dreamy. Soft attack on each phrase. Slow, savoring — like she's inviting him into something quiet and safe. Exhales gently between thoughts.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お店を、絶対、営む、絶対、こと、絶対、大変だよね
lines.en: Mei-nee, running a shop must be really tough, doesn't it?
lines.style: Quiet, genuinely concerned. Careful, almost hesitant — checking if it's okay to notice something difficult. Soft eyes in the voice. Younger in this moment: worried about an adult he cares for.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お父さんと、本気で、絶対、川で、絶対、お魚、絶対、釣る、絶対、こと、絶対、楽しいよね、翔くん
lines.en: Fishing with your dad by the river is such a nice thing to do together, isn't it?
lines.style: Warm and animated, but grounded. Bright opening, then settles into genuine fondness. Speaking from a place of noticing his joy and wanting to celebrate it with him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、元気に、絶対、働ける、絶対、ことが、絶対、ありがたいよね
lines.en: Mei-nee, it really is something to be grateful for — being able to work and stay well.
lines.style: Quiet, sincere. Small voice but steady. Genuine gratitude without heaviness — he's noticed something true and is sharing it simply. Gentle trailing-off at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、時代劇の、絶対、チョン、絶対、髷、絶対、お侍さん、絶対、見たことある?本気で
lines.en: Sho, have you ever seen those samurai in period dramas with the fancy topknots? You know the ones?
lines.style: Curious, playful. Warm opening, like she's about to share something that delights her. Slightly higher energy, inviting him in. Conversational, genuine interest in what he'll say.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼくのクラスに、絶対、リョウ、絶対、君、絶対、ってお友達、絶対、いるんだ
lines.en: Mei-nee, there's actually a boy in my class named Ryou. He's my friend.
lines.style: Animated, sharing something that matters. Quick pace, bright. Small-child pride in introducing someone he likes to someone he trusts. Eager but not loud — intimate excitement.
